title: SF.gov — Learn about rent increases in San Francisco
used_for: 1.6% rate (effective 3/1/2026–2/28/2027), 30/90-day notice rule, banking rule, no extra charge for additional occupants.

title: SF.gov — The Rent Board Housing Inventory (FAQ)
used_for: All residential owners (including individuals / small buildings) must report; reporting a tenant-occupied unit auto-generates a rent-increase license; license must be in effect on the effective date; deadline March 1; no monetary late penalty but unlicensed increases are unenforceable.

title: SF.gov — New Legislation Creates A Housing Inventory And Requires Owners To Obtain a License Before Imposing Annual/Banked Rent Increases (Ordinance 265-20, eff. 1/18/2021)
used_for: Effective dates (7/1/2022 for 10+ units; 3/1/2023 for condos and 1–9 unit buildings); license suspension during noncompliance.

title: SF.gov — Annual Rent Increase for 3/1/26 – 2/28/27 Announced (1.6%)
SF.gov — Current Rates, including Rent Increase, Relocation, Sec. Deposit
used_for: Published rate table and Form 571 link.

title: SF.gov — Form 571 Allowable Annual Increases (2026–2027, English)
used_for: Year-by-year allowable rates used for banking calculations.

title: California Civil Code § 827 — Notice of rent increase (state notice periods)
used_for: 30-day notice for ≤10%, 90-day notice for >10%; service by mail under CCP §1013.

title: California Code of Civil Procedure § 1013 — Service by mail (+5 days in-state)
used_for: Additional 5 calendar days when a notice is mailed within California.

title: California Civil Code § 1947.12 — Tenant Protection Act (state rent cap)
used_for: Statewide 5%+CPI cap (max 10%) — preempted for units already covered by a stricter local ordinance (SF rent control is stricter).

title: California Government Code § 12955 — Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA, discrimination)
used_for: Protected classes under state law (source of income, immigration status, etc., added locally in SF). Discriminatory rent terms are unlawful.

title: 42 U.S.C. § 3604 — Federal Fair Housing Act
used_for: Federal prohibition on discriminatory terms and conditions; no federal rent ceiling for private market housing.

title: SF Rent Board Portal (Housing Inventory / License lookup / fee payment)
used_for: Where individual owners file the Housing Inventory and obtain the rent-increase license; tenants can verify license status here too.

title: SF.gov — Rent Board Fee information
used_for: Annual Rent Board fee is $59 per dwelling unit (2026–27); separate from the license; 50% may be recoverable from tenants as a fee passthrough (not as rent).

title: SF Rent Board Rules and Regulations, Part 4 — Annual Increases (banking Rule 4.12)
used_for: Banking: unused increases are added, not compounded; anniversary-date rules; banking look-back period (12 months per Rule 4.12(a)).
